hooks.command: printf '[context] %s | branch: %s | dirty: %s file(s)\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')" "$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)" "$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

f=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -o '"file_path"[^,}]*' | head -1 | sed 's/.*: *"//;s/"$//'); case "$f" in *.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; rel=${f#"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/"}; docker compose run --rm --no-deps ingest ruff format "$rel" >/dev/null 2>&1; docker compose run --rm --no-deps ingest ruff check --fix "$rel" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0
